title: Robust Recourse under Causal Graph Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2611.34723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal algorithmic recourse recommends actions to reverse unfavorable decisions by modeling how interventions change an individual's features. Existing methods typically assume one causal graph that describes the system and account for uncertainty in the causal mechanisms. However, there usually exist several graphs that fit the same data but can predict different effects for the same action. Certain actions may achieve recourse across multiple graphs, but as the set of potential graphs grows, a single best action may become infeasible.   We propose Worst-Case Recourse and Graph-Weighted Recourse to find a low-cost action that succeeds across all candidate graphs or a specified fraction of graph weight, respectively. Assuming a set of plausible graphs, for each graph we fit Gaussian process structural equations and assess success using the posterior mean--standard-deviation criterion. translated_title: 因果图模糊性下的鲁棒算法补救
translated_abstract: 因果算法补救通过建模干预如何改变个体特征，向个体推荐行动以扭转不利的决策结果。现有方法通常假设仅存在单一因果图来描述系统，并考虑因果机制中的不确定性。然而，实际上通常存在多个符合相同数据但对同一干预行动可能预测出不同效果的因果图。某些行动或许能在多个图上都实现补救，但随着潜在因果图集合的增大，单一最优行动可能变得不可行。我们提出了“最坏情况补救”和“图加权补救”两种方法，分别用于寻找在所有候选图上均能成功、或在指定的图权重比例上成功的低成本行动。在假设存在一组合理因果图的前提下，我们对每个图拟合高斯过程结构方程，并采用后验均值-标准差准则来评估行动的成功性。我们使用基于梯度的搜索方法来确定最小成本的行动。
tldr: 针对因果图存在歧义的问题，提出了最坏情况补救和图加权补救两种方法，通过梯度搜索找到在多个候选因果图上均有效的低成本补救行动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Worst-Case Recourse and Graph-Weighted Recourse to find low-cost actions that succeed across multiple plausible causal graphs under causal graph ambiguity.
